stories.title: In Parlamento la discussione su scostamento e Dpfp

en.title: Parliamentary discussion on budget adjustment and DPFP
en.summary: Parliament held a vote on resolutions regarding a budget adjustment and the Fiscal-Structural Policy Framework in late morning.

stories.title: A.Fontana, nessuno di noi ha chiesto il congresso della Lega, il Nord va avanti

en.title: A. Fontana: no one among us requested a Lega congress, the North moves forward
en.summary: A Fontana stated that no particular issue was raised by the group and indicated that northern Italy continues progressing.

stories.title: Ruling against MEP Salis for unfair dismissal of assistants overturned

en.title: Ruling against MEP Salis for unfair dismissal of assistants overturned
en.summary: A court decision regarding unfair dismissal charges against MEP Salis was overturned and the case returned to first-instance court.

stories.title: Falli, espulsioni, rigori e Var: la serie A torna indietro e la linea Orsato vacilla

en.title: Fouls, red cards, penalties and VAR: Serie A steps back and the Orsato line wavers
en.summary: Serie A experienced changes in officiating standards regarding fouls, dismissals, and penalty decisions, affecting the consistency of the Orsato approach.

stories.title: Il Papa atteso al Gemelli. L'annuncio domenica dopo l'Angelus: "Ho un nodulo al polmone"

en.title: Pope expected at Gemelli hospital. Announcement made Sunday after Angelus: "I have a lung nodule"
en.summary: The Pope announced after Sunday prayers that he has a lung nodule and will undergo surgery at Gemelli hospital, expected to last about ninety minutes. His schedule is suspended until October 20.

stories.title: Salis: 'Soddisfatta per la decisione, in primo grado non ho potuto difendermi'

en.title: Salis: 'Satisfied with the decision, I was unable to defend myself in the first instance'
en.summary: An individual expressed satisfaction with a judicial decision, noting that the first-instance trial proceeded without their presence or ability to mount a defense.

stories.title: Ilaria Salis, Tribunale di Milano annulla la sentenza di primo grado: "Riconosciute le mie ragioni"

en.title: Ilaria Salis, Milan Court annuls first-instance sentence: "My reasons recognized"
en.summary: A Milan court has overturned a first-instance ruling that ordered a European parliamentarian to pay over 300,000 euros to two former assistants she had dismissed. The case will now restart from the beginning.

stories.title: Ilaria Salis, annullata condanna sui risarcimenti agli ex collaboratori: “Riconosciute mie ragioni”

en.title: Ilaria Salis, compensation ruling overturned for former collaborators: "My reasons recognized"
en.summary: A previous court decision ordering 300,000 euros in payments to former staff members has been annulled, and the case will restart. The European parliamentarian characterized the original case as involving a media campaign against her.

stories.title: ++ Annullata la condanna a Ilaria Salis nella causa con gli ex collaboratori ++

en.title: ++ Ilaria Salis conviction annulled in dispute with former collaborators ++
en.summary: An appeals court granted a request from Salis's lawyers, vacating her conviction and returning the case to trial court.

stories.title: Ricina, l’analisi dei pc all’istituto agrario: spunta l’ipotesi che il bersaglio fosse Di Vita

en.title: Ricin, computer analysis at agricultural institute: hypothesis emerges that target was Di Vita
en.summary: Prosecutors in Larino ordered searches at schools where suspects in a ricin poisoning case work, with evidence suggesting one victim may have been the intended target.

stories.title: Avvelenate con ricina, trappola ricerche web. Al via perquisizione nell'istituto agrario di Riccia

en.title: Poisoned with ricin, web search trap. Search underway at Riccia agricultural institute
en.summary: Police conducted a search at a school where the husband of a suspect's acquaintance is employed in connection with a ricin poisoning investigation.

stories.title: Morte avvelenate, al via la perquisizione nell'istituto agrario di Riccia

en.title: Poisoning deaths, search underway at Riccia agricultural institute
en.summary: Police searched a school where the husband of an acquaintance of a poisoning victim is employed as part of a ricin poisoning investigation.
